prompt: Epoxide ring opening: propylene oxide + CH₃O⁻. Draw the major product (basic conditions, attack at less hindered carbon).

traps.note: Under acid, attack goes to more substituted; under base, to less hindered.

explanation: Under BASIC conditions, nucleophile attacks the LESS substituted carbon (SN2-like). Under ACIDIC conditions, attack happens at the MORE substituted carbon (carbocation-like).
